record.field: # ===================================================================== # Cancel purchase orders through the native flow. Action 1649. # Type: "Ejecutar código". Allowed group: Compras / Administrador. # button_cancel() refuses orders with done receipts or posted bills # and cancels their pending pickings, unlike writing state directly. # ===================================================================== records.button_cancel()

# ============================================================ # [PRUEBA / DRY RUN] Confirm purchase order — retry logic test. # ============================================================ # This action exercises the FULL retry pipeline (savepoints, error # classification, chatter writes, bus notifications, pg_sleep, # transactional commits) WITHOUT ever calling button_confirm. # # The order state, lines, taxes, stock moves — none of that is # touched. Only the chatter gains test-marked messages. # # Use this to validate behavior in production safely. When done, # DELETE this server action and use the real one. # ============================================================ # CS50-style: explicit constants at top, guard clauses, single # responsibility per block, defensive against silent failures. # Safe_eval-compliant: no imports, no def, no attribute assignment, # no `with` statements (manual SAVEPOINT via SQL). # ============================================================ # --- DRY RUN scenario ---------------------------------------- # Choose which scenario to simulate: # 1 = transient 403, success at attempt DRY_RUN_SUCCESS_AT # (validates: retries, toasts, sleeps, recovery, chatter) # 2 = transient 403 that never recovers # (validates: full retry exhaustion + final UserError) # 3 = permanent error (Missing Califrais ID) # (validates: short-circuit on denylist, no retry, no sleep) DRY_RUN_SCENARIO = 1 DRY_RUN_SUCCESS_AT = 3 # ------------------------------------------------------------- # --- Configuration (mirrors the real action) ----------------- MAX_ATTEMPTS = 4 RETRY_DELAY_SECONDS = 10 RETRYABLE_API_TOKEN = "rungismarket" RETRYABLE_STATUS_TOKENS = ("Status Code: 403", "403 Forbidden") NEVER_RETRY_TOKENS = ( "Missing Califrais ID", "does not exist in Califrais", "Internal Server Error", "Status Code: 500", "\"status\":500", ) RETRYABLE_LABEL = "API externa rungismarket" CONFIRMABLE_STATES = ("draft", "sent") NOTIF_CHANNEL = env.user.partner_id NOTIF_TYPE = "simple_notification" TEST_TAG = "[PRUEBA] " # visible marker on every chatter/toast message # Simulated error strings (mirror real-world payloads) ------- SIM_TRANSIENT_ERROR = ( "[SIMULADO] URL: https://rungismarket.com/api/buyer/delivery_day, " "Status Code: 403, Response: 403 Forbidden" ) SIM_PERMANENT_ERROR = "[SIMULADO] Missing Califrais ID for Test Product" # ------------------------------------------------------------- for order in records: # Guard: skip orders that are not in a confirmable state. if order.state not in CONFIRMABLE_STATES: order.message_post( body=TEST_TAG + "Acción ignorada: el pedido ya está en estado " + str(order.state) + "." ) continue # Announce the test in the chatter so the user knows what to expect. order.message_post( body=TEST_TAG + "Iniciando simulación. Escenario: " + str(DRY_RUN_SCENARIO) + ". " "El pedido NO va a confirmarse — solo se ejerce la lógica de reintentos." ) confirmed = False last_error_msg = "" for attempt in range(1, MAX_ATTEMPTS + 1): sp_name = "sp_test_" + str(order.id) + "_" + str(attempt) env.cr.execute("SAVEPOINT " + sp_name) attempt_succeeded = False try: # ===== SIMULATION ===== # The real action calls order.button_confirm() here. # We replace it with a controlled exception (or no-op # for simulated success) so the order state is untouched. if DRY_RUN_SCENARIO == 1: if attempt < DRY_RUN_SUCCESS_AT: raise Exception(SIM_TRANSIENT_ERROR) # Otherwise: simulated success — do nothing, fall through. elif DRY_RUN_SCENARIO == 2: raise Exception(SIM_TRANSIENT_ERROR) elif DRY_RUN_SCENARIO == 3: raise Exception(SIM_PERMANENT_ERROR) else: raise Exception( "[SIMULADO] DRY_RUN_SCENARIO no válido: " + str(DRY_RUN_SCENARIO) ) # ===== END SIMULATION ===== attempt_succeeded = True except Exception as err: env.cr.execute("ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT " + sp_name) order.invalidate_recordset() last_error_msg = str(err) # --- Error classification (identical to production) --- is_blocked = False for token in NEVER_RETRY_TOKENS: if token in last_error_msg: is_blocked = True mentions_api = RETRYABLE_API_TOKEN in last_error_msg has_retry_status = False for token in RETRYABLE_STATUS_TOKENS: if token in last_error_msg: has_retry_status = True is_retryable = mentions_api and has_retry_status and not is_blocked # --- End classification --- if not is_retryable: order.message_post( body=TEST_TAG + "Error no recuperable (clasificación correcta — " "no se reintenta):
" + last_error_msg + "
" ) # In production this would `raise` the original exception. # In dry-run we raise UserError so Odoo shows a clean # modal without a Python traceback. raise UserError( TEST_TAG + "Simulación de error no recuperable propagada correctamente.\n\n" + last_error_msg ) if attempt_succeeded: env.cr.execute("RELEASE SAVEPOINT " + sp_name) confirmed = True if attempt > 1: order.message_post( body=TEST_TAG + "Confirmación SIMULADA exitosa en el intento " + str(attempt) + " de " + str(MAX_ATTEMPTS) + " (" + RETRYABLE_LABEL + " estabilizada)." ) env["bus.bus"]._sendone(NOTIF_CHANNEL, NOTIF_TYPE, { "title": TEST_TAG + "Pedido " + order.name + " (simulado)", "message": "Confirmación simulada lograda en el intento " + str(attempt) + " de " + str(MAX_ATTEMPTS) + ".", "type": "success", "sticky": False, }) else: # Scenario 1 with DRY_RUN_SUCCESS_AT = 1 would land here. order.message_post( body=TEST_TAG + "Confirmación SIMULADA exitosa al primer intento " "(sin reintentos necesarios)." ) break # ----- Failure path ----- if attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS: order.message_post( body=TEST_TAG + "Intento final " + str(attempt) + "/" + str(MAX_ATTEMPTS) + " fallido (" + RETRYABLE_LABEL + ")." ) break wait_text = (TEST_TAG + "Intento " + str(attempt) + "/" + str(MAX_ATTEMPTS) + " fallido. Reintentando en " + str(RETRY_DELAY_SECONDS) + " segundos...") order.message_post(body=wait_text + " (" + RETRYABLE_LABEL + ")") env["bus.bus"]._sendone(NOTIF_CHANNEL, NOTIF_TYPE, { "title": TEST_TAG + "Reintentando " + order.name, "message": wait_text, "type": "warning", "sticky": False, }) env.cr.commit() env.cr.execute("SELECT pg_sleep(%s)", (RETRY_DELAY_SECONDS,)) if not confirmed: order.message_post( body=TEST_TAG + "Simulación: no se pudo confirmar tras " + str(MAX_ATTEMPTS) + " intentos. Último error:
" "
" + last_error_msg + "
" ) env["bus.bus"]._sendone(NOTIF_CHANNEL, NOTIF_TYPE, { "title": TEST_TAG + "Confirmación fallida: " + order.name, "message": "Simulación: " + str(MAX_ATTEMPTS) + " intentos agotados.", "type": "danger", "sticky": True, }) raise UserError( TEST_TAG + "Simulación completada: " + str(MAX_ATTEMPTS) + " intentos agotados. " "Esto es el comportamiento esperado en escenario 2." )

# ============================================================ # [DIAG3] Last backend attempt: try with sudo. # If the token is read from a field on res.users, running as # superuser might pull a different (possibly fresh) token. # ============================================================ HARDCODED_ORDER_ID = 59163 CONFIRMABLE_STATES = ("draft", "sent") order = env["purchase.order"].browse(HARDCODED_ORDER_ID).exists() if order and order.state in CONFIRMABLE_STATES: # Same as before: switch to the order's company. # Then ALSO sudo: run as superuser, which may have a different token. order_to_confirm = order.with_company(order.company_id).sudo() sp_name = "sp_diag3_" + str(order.id) env.cr.execute("SAVEPOINT " + sp_name) attempt_succeeded = False last_error_msg = "" try: order_to_confirm.button_confirm() attempt_succeeded = True except Exception as err: env.cr.execute("ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT " + sp_name) order.invalidate_recordset() last_error_msg = str(err) diag = ( "--- DIAG3: with_company + sudo ---
" "env.user original: " + str(env.user.name) + " (ID " + str(env.user.id) + ")
" "env tras sudo: " + str(order_to_confirm.env.user.name) + " (ID " + str(order_to_confirm.env.user.id) + ")
" "env.company tras sudo: " + str(order_to_confirm.env.company.name) + " (ID " + str(order_to_confirm.env.company.id) + ")" ) if attempt_succeeded: env.cr.execute("RELEASE SAVEPOINT " + sp_name) order.message_post( body="[DIAG3] EXITO con sudo
" + diag, body_is_html=True, ) else: order.message_post( body="[DIAG3] FALLO con sudo
" + diag + "

Error:
"
                 + last_error_msg + "
", body_is_html=True, )

COMPANY_ID = 7 DELIVERECT_ACCT = 6 SNOOZE_HOURS = 12
product_ids = env.context.get("active_ids", [])
if not product_ids: raise UserError("ERROR: no se recibio ningun product_id")
company = env["res.company"].browse(COMPANY_ID) account = env["deliverect.account"].sudo().browse(DELIVERECT_ACCT) pos = env["deliverect.pos"].sudo().with_company(COMPANY_ID).search( [("company_id", "=", COMPANY_ID)], limit=1)
now = datetime.datetime.utcnow() snooze_end = now + datetime.timedelta(hours=SNOOZE_HOURS)
plus_as_strings = [] for pid in product_ids: plus_as_strings.append(str(pid))
payload = { "account": account.account_id, "location": pos.location_id, "plus": plus_as_strings, "snoozeEnd": snooze_end.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z"), }
env["deliverect.api"].sudo().with_company(COMPANY_ID).post( "/products/snoozeByPlus", payload, company=company )

COMPANY_ID = 7 DELIVERECT_ACCT = 6
product_ids = env.context.get("active_ids", [])
if not product_ids: raise UserError("ERROR: no se recibio ningun product_id")
company = env["res.company"].browse(COMPANY_ID) account = env["deliverect.account"].sudo().browse(DELIVERECT_ACCT) pos = env["deliverect.pos"].sudo().with_company(COMPANY_ID).search( [("company_id", "=", COMPANY_ID)], limit=1)
now = datetime.datetime.utcnow() snooze_end = now - datetime.timedelta(minutes=1)
plus_as_strings = [] for pid in product_ids: plus_as_strings.append(str(pid))
payload = { "account": account.account_id, "location": pos.location_id, "plus": plus_as_strings, "snoozeEnd": snooze_end.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z"), }
env["deliverect.api"].sudo().with_company(COMPANY_ID).post( "/products/snoozeByPlus", payload, company=company )
